title: Gemini 3.8 Live adds real-time visual avatars for enterprise agents
friendlyTitle: Gemini can now speak through a live digital avatar
summary: Google introduced Live Avatar for Gemini 3.8 Live, pairing speech with low-latency generated video, multilingual lip-sync across 97 languages and asynchronous tool use. It is available in Gemini Enterprise, with custom-avatar creation restricted to approved organizations.
friendlySummary: Google’s new enterprise feature creates a video character that can listen, speak and use tools during a conversation. It supports 97 languages and marks its output with an AI watermark.
whyItMatters: Businesses can build more expressive service, training and guided-support agents that continue a conversation while fetching information in the background. Synthetic presence also raises identity and disclosure concerns, making Google’s SynthID watermarking and deployment controls important.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may make support and training feel more natural. People should still know when the person on screen is generated by AI.
